claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows an open cubby-style shelving unit with a hanging rail, consistent with an open wardrobe.

claims.claim: can be used at home or boutique
claims.evidence: This is a subjective usage claim about suitability, not something a photo can confirm or deny.

risks.risk: Overall structural integrity / stability of the frame
risks.proof: A video showing the unit being gently pushed or shaken to check wobble, plus a close-up of joints and legs

risks.risk: Wood condition - termite damage, rot, warping
risks.proof: Close-up photos of wood grain, corners, and underside/back panel in good light
risks.if_unproven: priced as having hidden wood damage

risks.risk: Hanging rail condition - bent, rusted, or loose
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rail and its mounting points, plus a clip of it bearing weight

risks.risk: Dimensions unknown - may not fit intended space
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure against height, width, and depth of the unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified size, buyer assumes risk of misfit

risks.risk: Whether clothes/items shown are included in sale
risks.proof: Seller's explicit written confirmation plus a photo of the empty unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as furniture only, clothes excluded

risks.risk: Number and usable size of compartments not confirmed
risks.proof: Photo from a straight angle showing all compartments clearly, with a ruler for scale
risks.if_unproven: priced as smaller/fewer usable compartments than appears

proof_requests: Video of the wardrobe being shaken/pushed to show stability
Close-up photos of wood corners, back panel, and hanging rail
Photo with a tape measure showing height, width, depth
Clear statement on whether clothes are included in the sale
Close-up of compartments from a straight-on angle
response.reason: The witness clearly identified a wooden open wardrobe/shelving unit, so it can be priced at worst case pending proof of structural and material condition.
